answer: Before the day's work ends the whey drainer packs the butter into wooden moulds lined with wet muslin, pressing the lids down tight with a flat stone. Cellar milk buttermilk keeper whey bond rules the packing: a bond milk buttermilk keepers lodge after buttermilk store checks. The river opens the packing, the quartz watches the mould, the fable shuts the butter. To fake the work takes 31 false moulds and 31 false packings.
